> Generated by stewards from `.stewards/units/setup.toml`; change prose through the documenter.

# setup: Onboarding and generated files\: init proposes units and writes .stewards, the guide and AGENTS.md block, the per-harness facts table, and docs rendering from unit cards.

## Overview

The setup unit is how a repository gets onto stewards and how the generated files stay true. It proposes units for a repo and writes .stewards, writes the stewards block into AGENTS.md, tells each agent harness how to delegate, and renders human documentation pages from the unit cards. A reader meets it as three commands, init, guide and docs, plus the harness table that guide and init draw on.

## How it works

Plain init (src/init.rs, propose) refuses with already_initialized if units.toml or repo.toml exists. Otherwise it proposes units from manifest roots, source directories and co-change history, naming the repo after its origin remote (the last URL segment without .git), else its directory. It writes both files, appends the missing .gitignore lines (a line with or without a leading or trailing slash counts as present), upserts the AGENTS.md block, and reports what it wrote. init --draft (draft_jobs) runs only that first step on an uninitialized repo, then briefs one architect job to name the units plus a first review for each never-reviewed unit, each with its handoff, and ends telling to run review --roles until it exits 0. With --direct it checks every model guard first, then submits each job; if one fails it reports how many were already submitted. init --hooks and --ci return not_implemented. src/guide.rs holds the AGENTS.md block: upsert_block writes it at the top of the file (creating it) or replaces the text between the existing markers, returning whether the file changed. guide's run prints the block's ritual, handoff, editing and hygiene paragraphs, the roles and adoption text, and one delegation text for every harness: the generic paragraph plus, for the named or detected harness, the name of its subagent tool; a name not in the table gets the generic text. --all, --errors and --glossary add every harness, the error table and the glossary. src/harness.rs holds the facts table: detect returns the first harness whose env var prefix matches (an unverified env rule is never detected), and by_name looks one up case-insensitively, failing with harness_unknown and the valid names. src/docs.rs (pages) renders docs_path/&lt;unit>.md for one or all units, plus README.md, from cards, tests and repo.toml. It escapes card text, links live anchors, rejects an empty docs_path or one that escapes the repo and an unknown unit, and writes only changed files.

## How to change it

Start from the file for the command: src/init.rs for proposing units and draft jobs, src/guide.rs for the AGENTS.md block and guide text, src/harness.rs for per-harness facts, src/docs.rs for rendered pages. Each has a test file in tests/ (init.rs, init_draft.rs, guide.rs, docs.rs); change the test with the behavior. Keep true what the contracts promise: plain init never overwrites an initialized repo; init --draft only runs on an uninitialized repo and checks every model guard before any --direct call; the .gitignore step only appends and never duplicates a line already there in another spelling; upsert_block stays idempotent and touches only the text between its markers; a harness is only detected when its env rule is verified, and an unknown name stays harness_unknown with the valid names; docs refuses a docs_path that is empty or escapes the repo and rewrites only changed files. Look up the repo, its cards and a unit through the shared helpers rather than writing a local copy. Keep the card's interface table in step when a contract changes.

## Interface

| id | contract | anchor |
|---|---|---|
| init | Plain \`init\` refuses (already\_initialized) if units.toml or repo.toml exists; else proposes units, writes both files (repo name\: origin URL's last segment sans .git, else dir name), appends missing .gitignore lines (slashes at either end ignored), upserts the AGENTS.md block, and reports. | [src/init.rs\:\:propose](../../src/init.rs#L1) |
| init-draft | \`init --draft\` runs step 1 only on an uninitialized repo, briefs the architect naming job and a first review per never-reviewed unit, each with its handoff, then says to run \`review --roles\`; with --direct it checks every model guard, then submits each job; a failure reports how many were submitted. | [src/init.rs\:\:draft\_jobs](../../src/init.rs#L429) |
| init-hooks-ci | \`init --hooks\` and \`init --ci\` return not\_implemented. | [src/init.rs\:\:not\_implemented](../../src/init.rs#L14) |
| agents-block | Writes the stewards block at the top of AGENTS.md (creating the file), or replaces the text between existing start/end markers; returns whether the file changed, so a rerun is a no-op. | [src/guide.rs\:\:upsert\_block](../../src/guide.rs#L47) |
| guide | \`guide\` prints the block's ritual, handoff, editing and hygiene paragraphs, roles, adoption, and the generic delegation plus the named or detected harness's subagent tool, if any; an unknown --harness gets generic text; --all, --errors, --glossary add every harness, the error table, the glossary. | [src/guide.rs\:\:run](../../src/guide.rs#L20) |
| harness-detect | Returns the first harness whose env var prefix matches the current environment; harnesses with an unverified env rule are never detected. | [src/harness.rs\:\:detect](../../src/harness.rs#L166) |
| harness-by-name | Looks up a harness case-insensitively; an unknown name is harness\_unknown listing the valid names. | [src/harness.rs\:\:by\_name](../../src/harness.rs#L176) |
| docs | \`docs \[unit\]\` renders docs\_path/\<unit\>.md for one or every unit plus README.md from cards, tests and repo.toml, escaping card text and linking live anchors; rejects a docs\_path that is empty or escapes the repo and an unknown unit; writes only changed files. | [src/docs.rs\:\:pages](../../src/docs.rs#L41) |

| docs-escapes-markup-only | docs | an interface contract containing \| \\ \` \< \> \[ \] \! \* \_ \~ \& \# \: \@ and www\. (any case) | each markup-starting character is backslash-escaped, the table row keeps its 4 separators, and ordinary prose (commas, periods, hyphens, parentheses, slashes, semicolons) has no backslash | integration |
| init-gitignore-slash-variants | init | a .gitignore that already holds /.stewards/telemetry/ and /.stewards/briefs (leading slash, no trailing slash) | init treats both as present\: .gitignore is unchanged and not listed in wrote | integration |
| init-repo-name-from-origin | init | a git repo with an origin remote https\://example.invalid/acme/widgets.git | repo.toml name is widgets (origin URL last segment without .git); without an origin it falls back to the directory name | integration |
| init-draft-ends-with-next-roles | init-draft | a fresh git repo with two source dirs, run \`init --draft\` | jobs are the architect job and a maintainer first review per unit, each with handoff \`\`Read \`\<brief path\>\` and follow it.\`\`, and \`then\` ends with \`run stewards review --roles until it exits 0\` | integration |
| guide-unknown-harness-is-generic | guide | \`guide --harness emacs\` (a name not in the harness table) | exit 0, harness null, and the same delegation text as with no harness detected | integration |

## Flows

- documenter-card-to-docs-page: jobs → setup

## Gaps

| kind | title | note |
|---|---|---|
| future | init --hooks and --ci are not implemented | Both flags are parsed but return not\_implemented. |
| gap | guide paragraphs are picked by index from BLOCK | guide run splits BLOCK on blank lines and takes parts\[2..=5\]; adding or removing a paragraph in the block silently shifts which text each guide field shows. |
| gap | six harnesses are never detected from env | Harnesses with an unverified env rule are only reachable through guide --harness; detect and telemetry fall back to generic for them. |
| gap | Last reviewed commit is written at line start | esc assumes a tool-written prefix, but unit\_page writes reviewed.commit alone on its line and the commit is not validated; a hand-edited commit like \`1. x\` or \`---\` renders as a list or rule. Cosmetic only\: no HTML or link can form. |
